按官方第 1 章顺序整理地理信息、读取、连接与输出。打开课程 casa0005.Rproj，代码按顺序运行；Knit 从头计算普通分析块；安装、导出与可选联网分支单独执行。

来源：MacLachlan、Dennett、Dooley；CC BY-SA 4.0。中文整理与适配经 AI 辅助，见改编范围；源版本 0b19a3339034e3bd3de1e8246559d453301f07eb。

1.4 数据与 Excel 透视表

原始数据来自 London Data Store，存于 data/raw/london/。Shapefile 的 shp、shx、dbf、prj 配套保留。Excel 透视表以地区代码为行、年份为列、total_action_taken 为值并求和，去掉额外标题和总计，另存 week01/data/processed/fly-tipping-pivot.csv。

1.5 包与项目

安装块仅在缺包时运行。

install.packages(c("sf", "tidyverse", "tmap", "RSQLite"))

加载工具

sf 处理矢量，tidyverse 整理表格，tmap 制图，RSQLite 读写数据库。

helper <- c("tutorial-tools.R", "../tutorial-tools.R")
source(helper[file.exists(helper)][1])
gis_packages(c("sf", "tidyverse", "tmap", "RSQLite"))
## Registered S3 method overwritten by 'stars':
##   method                  from
##   st_interpolate_aw.stars sf
library(sf)
## Linking to GEOS 3.13.0, GDAL 3.8.5, PROJ 9.5.1; sf_use_s2() is TRUE
library(tidyverse)
## ── Attaching core tidyverse packages ──────────────────────── tidyverse 2.0.0 ──
## ✔ dplyr     1.2.1     ✔ readr     2.2.0
## ✔ forcats   1.0.1     ✔ stringr   1.6.0
## ✔ ggplot2   4.0.3     ✔ tibble    3.3.1
## ✔ lubridate 1.9.5     ✔ tidyr     1.3.2
## ✔ purrr     1.2.2
## ── Conflicts ────────────────────────────────────────── tidyverse_conflicts() ──
## ✖ dplyr::filter() masks stats::filter()
## ✖ dplyr::lag()    masks stats::lag()
## ℹ Use the conflicted package (<http://conflicted.r-lib.org/>) to force all conflicts to become errors
library(tmap)
root <- gis_root()

读取边界

shape 包含行政区属性和 geometry；st_crs() 查看坐标参考系，st_geometry() 只取形状。

boundary <- gis_file("data/raw/london/boundaries/statistical-gis-boundaries-london/ESRI/London_Borough_Excluding_MHW.shp",
                     "^London_Borough_Excluding_MHW\\.shp$")
shape <- sf::st_read(boundary, quiet = TRUE)
gis_unique(shape, "GSS_CODE")
summary(shape)

##  Max.nchar:22   Max.nchar: 9   3rd Qu.: 5658.5   3rd Qu.: 95.60

读取属性表

优先读取本周透视表；否则使用保留的 GB18030 中文宽表，规范代码、年份和总计字段。

pivot_file <- file.path(root, "week01/data/processed/fly-tipping-pivot.csv")
if (file.exists(pivot_file)) {
  mycsv <- readr::read_csv(pivot_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {

  mycsv <- readr::read_csv(
    gis_file("data/raw/london/attributes/fly-tipping-borough.csv"),
    locale = readr::locale(encoding = "GB18030"), show_col_types = FALSE)
}
names(mycsv)
##  [1] "行标签"    "2012-13"   "2013-14"   "2014-15"   "2015-16"   "2016-17"  
##  [7] "2017-18"   "2018-19"   "2019-20"   "2020-21"   "2021-22"   "2022-23"  
## [13] "2023-24"   "2024-25"   "2011/12/1" "总计"
if ("Row Labels" %in% names(mycsv)) mycsv <- dplyr::rename(mycsv, GSS_CODE = `Row Labels`)
if ("行标签" %in% names(mycsv)) mycsv <- dplyr::rename(mycsv, GSS_CODE = `行标签`)
if ("2011/12/1" %in% names(mycsv)) mycsv <- dplyr::rename(mycsv, `2011_12` = `2011/12/1`)
gis_columns(mycsv, "GSS_CODE")
mycsv <- mycsv %>%
  dplyr::filter(GSS_CODE != "总计") %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("总计")) %>%
  dplyr::rename_with(~ gsub("-", "_", .x))
gis_unique(mycsv, "GSS_CODE")

按代码连接

两侧 anti_join() 检查未匹配，唯一键验证后执行一对一左连接。

if (!exists("shape", inherits = FALSE)) {
  stop("当前会话没有 shape：请先运行 read-boundary，再运行本块。", call. = FALSE)
}
if (!exists("mycsv", inherits = FALSE)) {
  stop("当前会话没有 mycsv：请先运行 read-pivot，再运行本块。", call. = FALSE)
}
gis_unique(shape, "GSS_CODE")
gis_unique(mycsv, "GSS_CODE")
dplyr::anti_join(sf::st_drop_geometry(shape), mycsv, by = "GSS_CODE")
## [1] NAME       GSS_CODE   HECTARES   NONLD_AREA ONS_INNER  SUB_2009   SUB_2006  
## <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
dplyr::anti_join(mycsv, sf::st_drop_geometry(shape), by = "GSS_CODE")
## # A tibble: 0 × 15
## # ℹ 15 variables: GSS_CODE <chr>, 2012_13 <dbl>, 2013_14 <dbl>, 2014_15 <dbl>,
## #   2015_16 <dbl>, 2016_17 <dbl>, 2017_18 <dbl>, 2018_19 <dbl>, 2019_20 <dbl>,
## #   2020_21 <dbl>, 2021_22 <dbl>, 2022_23 <dbl>, 2023_24 <dbl>, 2024_25 <dbl>,
## #   2011_12 <dbl>
shape2 <- dplyr::left_join(shape, mycsv, by = "GSS_CODE", relationship = "one-to-one")
stopifnot(nrow(shape2) == nrow(shape))
head(sf::st_drop_geometry(shape2), 10)

专题地图

2011_12 表示 2011–12 年采取行动次数，不是事件总数；缺失值保留为 NA。

year_column <- "2011_12"
gis_columns(shape2, year_column)
tmap::tmap_mode("plot")
## ℹ tmap modes "plot" - "view"
## ℹ toggle with `tmap::ttm()`
tmap::tm_shape(shape2) + tmap::tm_polygons(fill = year_column)

导出 GeoPackage

导出连接后的 shape2，另加 original_csv 表；时间戳文件名保留旧结果。

target <- gis_new_output("week01", paste0("flytipping-tutorial-",
  format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"), ".gpkg"))
sf::st_write(shape2, target, layer = "london_boroughs_fly_tipping", quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), dbname = target)
tryCatch({
  print(DBI::dbListTables(con))
  DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "original_csv", as.data.frame(mycsv), overwrite = FALSE)
}, finally = DBI::dbDisconnect(con))
sf::st_layers(target)

Homework：新西兰

使用 Territorial Authority 2018 generalised 边界和 Census 的 2018 paid employee。此块仅检查工作表，完整处理见 homework.Rmd。SA1 与 territorial authority 是不同空间层级。

library(readxl)
census <- gis_file("data/raw/nz2018/census/2018-SA1-dataset-individual-part-3a-total-NZ_updated_16-7-20.xlsx")
readxl::excel_sheets(census)
preview <- readxl::read_excel(census, sheet = "Territorial authority", col_names = FALSE, n_max = 12)
preview

课堂结果与图片见 运行记录。阅读：Goodchild，Geocomputation with R 第 2 章。
